sentences.text: Today we will talk about Mongolia.
Mongolia is a country of big skies, wide grasslands, and strong traditions.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Mongolia?
Mongolia is in Asia.
It is between Russia in the north and China in the south.
It has no sea.
It is a landlocked country.
Mongolia has deserts, mountains, and open land called steppe.
What is the capital city of Mongolia?
The capital city is Ulaanbaatar.
It is the largest city in the country.
Ulaanbaatar has tall buildings, traffic, and cold winters.
Many people move there from the countryside.
How many people live in Mongolia?
About three.
Four million people live in Mongolia.
It is a large country with a small population.
Most people live in Ulaanbaatar or in rural areas.
Many families are nomadic.
They move with their animals.
What language do people speak in Mongolia?
People speak Mongolian.
It is the official language and is written using the Cyrillic alphabet.
Some people also speak Russian, English, or Chinese.
In the West, people may speak Kazakh.
What is the weather like in Mongolia?
Mongolia has a harsh continental climate.
Summers are short and warm.
Winters are long, cold, and dry.
In some places, it can be 90 -40 degrees Celsius in winter.
The sky is often blue and clear.
Mongolia is called the land of blue sky.
What does Mongolia look like?
Mongolia has flat grasslands called steppe, the Gobi Desert in the south, mountains in the west and north, rivers, lakes, and forests.
There are many open spaces and few trees in the central region.
What animals live in Mongolia?
In Mongolia, you can see horses, camels, yaks, sheep, and goats, eagles, vultures, and cranes, wolves, snow leopards, and foxes.
Horses are very important in Mongolian life and culture.
What do people eat in Mongolia?
Mongolian food is meaty, simple, and made for cold weather.

People eat mutton, sheep, beef, and goat meat, dairy products, milk, yogurt, and cheese, flour, rice, and noodles, popular dishes, booze, steamed meat dumplings, kusher fried meat pies, sui van, noodle and meat stir -fry, airog, fermented horse milk, bortsog fried dough snacks.
What do people drink in Mongolia?
People drink milk tea with salt and butter, airog, sour horse milk, water, tea, and sometimes coffee.
In the city, also soda or juice.
Tea is warm and salty, perfect for the cold climate.
What is life like in Mongolia?
Life in Mongolia can be very different in the city and in the countryside.
In the countryside, many families live in jurors, round tents, they move to find grass for animals, people ride horses, cook over fire, and live simply.
In the city, people live in apartments.
They go to school, work, shops, and cafes.
Life is busy and modern.
What are some holidays and traditions in Mongolia?
Not a festival.
In July, with wrestling, horse racing, and archery.
Saigon Saar, lunar new year with big family meals.
Independence Day, December 29th.
Winter Festival with ice games and traditional clothes.
Mongolians wear deal, a long coat, and enjoy music, dance, and storytelling.
Some fun facts about Mongolia.
Mongolia has more horses than people.
Genghis Khan, the great leader was born in Mongolia.
People still live in jurors, even near the city.
The Gobi Desert is home to dinosaur fossils.
Mongolia has one of the lowest population densities in the world.
Now, you know many things about Mongolia.
You know where it is, what people eat, and how they live.
You learned about the land, the animals, and the traditions.
Great job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
